stories.title: The sales note went to the wrong address
stories.before: The first time the eval suite ran (10 cases then), one case failed: 5b. The agent correctly sent an 8-passenger change to sales for a re-quote, but addressed the note to ops@ instead of sales@, because no tool told it the sales address.
stories.change: Who receives a routing note is policy, not judgment. The agent now writes only the note; code addresses it to sales from the operator data (tools v3).
stories.after: Re-run after the fix: every case passed, 5 runs each.

stories.title: Medium effort missed the crew-swap option
stories.before: Demo change 2 at medium effort offered only "depart 17:45". High effort found the crew swap too, but cost 14¢ and took 82 seconds.
stories.change: The search for fixes moved into code: a find_duty_fixes tool tries the standard fixes and returns only those that pass every check, priced from the rate card (tools v2).
stories.after: Three verified options at medium effort, 7¢ and 17 seconds.
